messages:
joel: Quick report: customers are seeing billing vs console discrepancies. Traced a couple requests where runtime used `tenant-private` capacity but console showed `public-default`.
joel: Short repro (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"prompt":"hey"}'
```
(no x-route-hint header). Runtime logs show route resolved -> `tenant-private/region-a` but console attribution pipeline recorded `default` quota.
marie: Thanks. Did this start after the SDK header cleanup last sprint? We removed auto route hints in py/ts to avoid leaking infra topology.
aditya: Correct, SDKs now omit x-client-route by default. Previously clients sent an explicit hint which console used for attribution. Without the header, control and data planes are resolving differently.
tyler: This will create support noise. People will think tokens disappeared. We need a fix that's low-risk and reversible.
sam: Two options: (A) Gateway/runtime add a response header with the resolved route so console can retroactively attribute; (B) Make the control plane ask the runtime synchronously for resolved route during ingestion. Option A is less invasive.
joel: I prefer A. Runtime can set `X-ResRoute: tenant-private:region-a` on the response. Console ingester can pick that up from logs or async traces. No sync call.
aditya: Implementing response header is straightforward but edgecases: streaming responses, intermediate proxies might strip headers. Also CORS for browser clients?
marie: Good point about streaming. For chunked responses we can prefix the first chunk with a small metadata JSON if headers won't survive. But let's try headers first for server-to-server flows.
tyler: Meanwhile, SDKs should add ephemeral telemetry to measure the gap. Proposal: ship a tiny patch that emits sdk.event(route_hint.present=false) sampled 1% by default. No default behavioral change. Also show a deprecation log in DEBUG when route hint is missing.
sam: Agree. Devex should prepare a short doc and CLI flag `--send-route-hint` so customers can opt-in if they want strict attribution immediately.
joel: Can we also add a quick console dashboard showing "runtime route vs console quota" mismatch counts? That'll help SRE/support triage.
marie: Yes. Console team: add a tile that cross-tabulates by resolved-route header (once available) and console quota. Also add an alert if mismatch rate > 0.5% over 5m.
ingest-bot: Ticket created: CONSOLE-669 (ingest resolved-route header), RUNTIME-853 (add res header), SDK-312 (telemetry + warn).
aditya: I'll open a runtime draft PR that adds `X-Resolved-Route` and emits it for both normal and streaming responses (first-chunk metadata). Will make it guarded behind a feature flag `emit_resolved_route_v1` so we can roll back.
tyler: I'll prep the console ingestion change to read that header and map it to quota attribution in the ingestion pipeline. For backwards compatibility, fall back to existing behavior if header absent.
sam: SDKs: please do not flip defaults. We just need telemetry to decide next steps. If we later decide to restore hints by default, we should do a staged rollout (opt-in beta -> warn -> default change after 2 weeks).
joel: Timeline idea: runtime shim in canary within 36h, console ingestion + dashboard within 72h, SDK telemetry release tomorrow as a patch, customer-facing note if we see significant impact.
aditya: Working on runtime branch now. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/548 (feature-flagged). Includes unit tests that assert header present and first-chunk metadata for streams.
marie: I'll coordinate with devex on the CLI snippet and the warning text. Let's keep the internal comms simple: "observed quota attribution discrepancies for clients that omit route hints; we are deploying mitigations."
tyler: Also add an observability check: trace id mapping from ingress -> runtime -> console ingestion to verify attribution pipeline end-to-end in canary.
aditya: Pushed canary deploy request: deploy/canary/runtime/emit-resolved-route. ETA 90m.
joel: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: RUNTIME-853, CONSOLE-669, SDK-312. We'll review metrics in tomorrow eng-platform sync at 10am PT.
marie: small ask: add a sampled telemetry field `sdk.route_hint.source` with values ["explicit_header","absent"] so we can correlate by SDK version. No PII.
sam: Done. I'll also add a short note to the support runbook showing how to surface the resolved-route header and explain the discrepancy to customers.
joel: Closing loop: keep default SDK behavior stable for now; do fixes in runtime & console to reduce noise; collect telemetry and revisit default in two weeks.
tyler: +1. We'll monitor alerts and escalate if mismatch spikes.
